key_insight: Explainable deep reinforcement learning can optimize residential building energy management while making battery-control decisions transparent and trustworthy.
engineering_relevance: The framework helps lower electricity costs and improve operational control in PV-and-battery-equipped buildings under dynamic prices, forecasts, and weather conditions.
method: Train on-policy and off-policy DRL agents for building energy control
Use an expanded state space with demand, PV output, battery state, prices, weather, and calendar/holiday features
Apply post-hoc explanation methods to interpret learned policies
evidence_signal: The abstract reports evaluation on both synthetic data and real-world Living Lab Energy Campus data, with A2C and PPO outperforming off-policy methods in cumulative reward and policy stability.
watch_item: Explainability is post-hoc, so the insights may not fully capture the true internal reasoning of the DRL policy in all operating conditions.
paper_title: Explainable Data-driven Deep Reinforcement Learning Methods for Optimal Energy Management in Buildings
